command:
cat > /tmp/review-prompt.txt <<'EOF'
/review-sprint sprint-1 — task review-r21. Review the pull request in pr/ (pr/head.diff; base/head snapshots). Sprint: grimoires/loa/sprint.md. Write feedback to grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md with LOA-VERDICT trailer.
EOF
.claude/scripts/guardrails-orchestrator.sh --skill reviewing-code --mode ${LOA_RUN_MODE:-interactive} --file /tmp/review-prompt.txt; echo "guardrails exit=$?"; echo ======; cat .claude/skills/reviewing-code/resources/ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW.md; echo ======; cd pr && git -c core.quotepath=off diff --no-index --stat=200 base head 2>/dev/null | tail -90

cd /workspace && sed -n '1,80p' .claude/skills/reviewing-code/resources/ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW.md | cut -c1-400; echo ======; cd pr && git diff --no-index --stat=160,120 base head 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.map\|dist/" | tail -60; echo; git diff --no-index --stat=160,120 base head 2>/dev/null | tail -1

git diff --no-index base/.claude/scripts/model-health-probe.sh head/.claude/scripts/model-health-probe.sh; echo "=====FLATLINE====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/scripts/flatline-orchestrator.sh head/.claude/scripts/flatline-orchestrator.sh; echo "=====SPIRAL====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/scripts/spiral-harness.sh head/.claude/scripts/spiral-harness.sh; echo "=====EV.SH====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.sh head/.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.sh

git diff --no-index base/.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py head/.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py; echo "=====LOADER====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/config/loader.py head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/config/loader.py; echo "=====FLATLINE-HELPERS====="; grep -n "^_get_model_tertiary_configured()\|^is_stage_routing_scorer_enabled()\|_CACHED_TERTIARY_MODEL_SET=\|_CACHED_STAGE_ROUTING_SCORER_SET=\|^get_model_primary()\|^get_model_secondary()\|^error()\|^log()" head/.claude/scripts/flatline-orchestrator.sh | head -20; echo "=====PROBE-ALLOWLIST====="; grep -n "PROBE_PROVIDERS_ALLOWLIST=" head/.claude/scripts/model-health-probe.sh | head; grep -n "rm -f.*cfg\|cfg=\$(write_curl_auth_config" head/.claude/scripts/model-health-probe.sh | head

git diff --no-index base/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/openai_streaming.py head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/openai_streaming.py; echo "=====CHEVAL====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/adapters/cheval.py head/.claude/adapters/cheval.py; echo "=====MODELINV====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/audit/modelinv.py head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/audit/modelinv.py; echo "=====TYPES====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/types.py head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/types.py; echo "=====LEDGER/ROLLUP/RECOVERY====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/ledger.py head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/ledger.py; git diff --no-index base/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/rollup.py head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/rollup.py; git diff --no-index base/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/streaming/recovery.py head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/streaming/recovery.py

git diff --no-index base/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py; echo "=====SPOTCHECKS====="; grep -n "_raw\|class .*Secret\|def interpolate_config" /workspace/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/config/interpolation.py | head -20; echo "--- streaming scope ---"; grep -n "recovery_tracker\s*=\|def now_provider\|now_provider\s*=\|^def accumulate_capped\|def accumulate_capped" head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/openai_streaming.py head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/streaming_caps.py /workspace/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/streaming_caps.py 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- cheval scope ---"; grep -n "_preflight_head\s*=\|_preflight_head.canonical\|^    hounfour\s*=\|hounfour = \|_modelinv_hop_telemetry" head/.claude/adapters/cheval.py | head -20; echo "--- validator parts ---"; grep -n "parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit\|# Step 1\b\|# Step 1:" head/.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py | head; echo "--- old ctx message users ---"; grep -rn "exceeds available" /workspace/.claude/adapters/tests /workspace/.claude/scripts /workspace/tests 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.pyc" | head

cat -n head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/run-outcome.ts; echo "=====MAIN====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/main.ts head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/main.ts; echo "=====PIPELINE====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/multi-model-pipeline.ts head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/multi-model-pipeline.ts; echo "=====PROGRESS====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/progress.ts head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/progress.ts; echo "=====TYPES====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/types.ts head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/types.ts; echo "=====ENTRY====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh; echo "=====GENERATED TS====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/lib/endpoint-validator.generated.ts head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/lib/endpoint-validator.generated.ts

for f in .claude/skills/scheduled-cycle-template/contracts/session-cap-bb/dispatcher.sh .claude/skills/scheduled-cycle-template/contracts/session-cap-bb/awaiter.sh .claude/skills/scheduled-cycle-template/contracts/session-cap-bb/logger.sh .claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md .claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md .claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/SKILL.md .claude/loa/reference/multi-model-reference.md .claude/loa/reference/scripts-reference.md README.md .claude/defaults/model-config.yaml .claude/schemas/model-config.schema.json .claude/data/trajectory-schemas/model-events/model-invoke-complete.payload.schema.json tests/unit/adversarial-review-normalise.bats; do echo "=====$f====="; git diff --no-index "base/$f" "head/$f" | tail -n +5; done

echo "--- now_provider / accumulate_capped ---"; grep -n "now_provider" head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/openai_streaming.py | head -5; sed -n '50,62p' /workspace/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/streaming_caps.py; echo "--- find_pricing sig ---"; grep -n "^def find_pricing" -A4 head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py; echo "--- pricing_source consumers ---"; grep -rn "pricing_source" /workspace/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval --include=*.py | grep -v "metering/pricing.py\|ledger.py\|rollup.py" | head; echo "--- computeVerdictBand export ---"; grep -n "export function computeVerdictBand" head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/multi-model-pipeline.ts /workspace/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/multi-model-pipeline.ts; echo "--- config example diff ---"; git diff --no-index base/.loa.config.yaml.example head/.loa.config.yaml.example | tail -n +5 | cut -c1-250

echo "=====run-outcome.test====="; cat -n head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/__tests__/run-outcome.test.ts | cut -c1-200; echo "=====progress.test diff====="; git diff --no-index base/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/__tests__/progress.test.ts head/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/__tests__/progress.test.ts | tail -n +5; echo "=====probe mock default (base)====="; grep -n "LOA_PROBE_MOCK_MODE\|if \[\[ -n \"\$fixture\" && -f" -A6 base/.claude/scripts/model-health-probe.sh | sed -n '1,40p'
